title: Venezuelan Citrus Kissed Ceviche
description: A refreshing vegan ceviche dish from Venezuela, infused with citrus flavors and a kiss of something special.

ingredients.name: kissed
ingredients.notes: Use a variety that is kissed by the sun

ingredients.name: citrus
ingredients.notes: Mix of lime, lemon, and orange juice

ingredients.name: ceviche
ingredients.notes: Vegan ceviche made from plant-based ingredients

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the kissed, citrus, and ceviche.
Add the venezuelan aji amarillo pepper sauce and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in the ikura.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional kissed, if desired.
